arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Hi Priya,

Per our principal's request, please find below the Q1 market data information for Acme, as provided in your client's briefing records.

---
Q1 Acme Market Data (from client briefing records):

Category Share (Protein Bars):
- January: 18.4% (Nielsen scanner Q4–Q1 pull), share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset
- February: 18.6% (Nielsen scanner Feb pull), share holding — Verdant flat — see analyst note
- March: 18.9% (Nielsen scanner March pull), share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down

Retail Velocity (Protein Bar SKU):
- January: 4.7 units/store/week (IRI scan), steady — top-3 SKU in category
- February: 4.9 units/store/week (IRI scan), uptick — Q1 promo driving trial 
- March: 5.1 units/store/week (IRI scan), best Q1 reading — momentum continues

Regional Momentum:
- Southeast: +12% YoY (Jan, Acme syndicated dashboard), strongest region — pull-through from Walmart reset
- West: +8% YoY (Feb, Acme syndicated dashboard), below plan +12% — competitive pressure from private label
- Northeast: +9% YoY (Mar, Acme syndicated dashboard), steady — no notable competitive shifts

Promo Lift:
- January: +22% during MLK weekend reset (Acme syndicated dashboard), outperformed planned +15%
- February: +18% during Super Bowl window (Acme syndicated dashboard), met plan

Share of Voice (Digital):
- February: 33% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape), leading category — Verdant at 24%
- March: 34% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape), steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2

If you require the full data extract or have any specific data requests, please let us know.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
